# MnaPlayer+

> MnaPlayer+ is a free, ad-free, privacy-respecting music and media player for Android (Windows version too), made by MNA Labs. It plays the user's own files and lets users discover legal online content: Creative Commons music (Jamendo, Openverse, Internet Archive), internet radio (radio-browser.info), podcasts, and YouTube via the official YouTube player only. No accounts, no ads, no analytics, no own servers; online features are optional. 26 languages, automatic by phone language; content follows the phone's region. Status: coming soon to Google Play. Contact: mnaplayer.destek@gmail.com

## Key facts
- Price: free; no ads; no in-app purchases; no account.
- Privacy: library, playlists, collections and history stay on the device; no network requests when "Online" is off.
- YouTube: search via YouTube Data API; playback only in the official embedded player; no downloads, no background playback of YouTube.
- Downloads: only public-domain / Creative Commons music and podcast episodes, saved with licence and attribution.
- Voice search: uses Android's speech recognizer; the app requests no microphone permission.
